notes.title: Closed Beta Version 1.1.1 Build Notes
notes.notes:
[b]New features and fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a 3-second countdown sound effect in the Discography Shop!
[*] The timer in the Discography Shop now becomes RED when during the final 5 seconds
[*] Added a 10-second 2wrning sound effect in the Discography Shop!
[*] Reduced the number of prop cards in the card pools.
[*] Fixed how tooltips are displayed when a playing in Window mode
[*] Now there are 3 different new tutorials uploaded! Hover over the ‘Tutorial’ button on the main screen to see the options
[*] Added helpful text to every screen of the ‘Build/Edit band’ module’
[*] Fixed the displaying of Empty players’ slots in the Battle Lobby screen
[*] Added helpful text to the Staging screen
[*] Updated Managers’ descriptions in the Shop module
[*] Purchased items no longer disappear from the Shop; instead, you will see them as ‘Owned’
[*] Added info buttons to all in-game character cards. Hover over the ‘i’ button in the Shop on Managers/Band Members cards to see their details!
[*] Updated resizing logic in Window mode so it resizes correctly and no longer jitters.
[*] Adjusted Band Manager sprites
[*] Updated Round Result (Wrap Up) screen
[/list]

[b]Known Issues and bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] When the player joins the lobby, then leave it, and immediately joins again - he will see 2 instances of himself, it is not a bug, it is game logic, so the game creates ghost players when someone leaves the lobby/match
[*] At low specs PC, the game could have not enough time to load all the data, so the cases when players have some empty screens or blocks without text are OK
[*] Aria modules don’t disappear at the victory screen
[*] AVAST/AVG flags the .exe of the game as a virus
[*] Some abilities cards name text is too long and it overlaps with the logo
[*] In some very specific cases, the shield can remain on stage from the previous round
[*] Issues with Bella and sweet zombie ultimate camera movement. Bella camera angle is incorrect and the sweet zombie camera doesn't trigger
[*] Some members animations have clipping
[*] Sometimes in very specific cases after the enemy knocking the Bit Render - he starts floating
[*] The music stops playing after the player hit ‘READY’ button
[/list]

notes.title: Build Notes v0.9.0 - 7/30/21
notes.notes:
[b]Notes
[/b]- New stage design added to the roster
- Updated art for Lobby screen, Battle screen, Matchmaking screen, End Match screen, Wrap-up screen, Shop screen, Loading screen and Buying Gems popup
- Updated Sgt. Goldcap’s ability. Old ability: After round 5, abilities in the Discography Shop cost +1 Gold. New ability: After round 4, abilities in the Discography Shop cost +1 Gold
- Updated Ed Koch’s ability. Old ability: Refreshing an uninfected ability slot in the Discography Shop is free for rounds 8, 9, and 10. New ability: Refreshing an uninfected ability slot in the Discography Shop is free for rounds 6, 7, and 8
- Updated Dr. Wilhelm Arkin’s ability. Old ability: At the end of rounds 1 to 5, your opponent loses -1 Fame. New ability: At the end of rounds 1 to 4, your opponent loses -1 Fame
- Updated Hina Hatake’s ability. Old ability: At the end of round 10, receive +10 Fame. New ability: At the end of round 8, receive +8 Fame
- Updated Agent Jones’ ability. Old ability: After round 5, you and your opponent receive +1 Gold for every shield that is broken. New ability: After round 4, you and your opponent receive +1 Gold for every shield that is broken
- Added animation for matching up players
- Updated networking to display all data in the player slot in the lobby and round result screen
- Implemented waiting time in the lobby
- Updated player slot for lobby and round result player screen
- Added random tips system
- Added logic to select deck and initiate character spawning
- Updated discography shop screens
- New menu music for main menu and staging
- New audio stems for guest star attacks
- Updated common ui background
- Added empty slots to all UI
- Updated band member slot for build module and discography shop screens
- Updated right panel with band manager and band member slot for build module and discography shop screen
- Updated player slot for matchmaking and match result screen
- Updated main menu screen
- Removed the "0" that sometimes appeared onscreen while hover-overing
- All the players' props should disappear at the 'Victory' screen, including all types of shields of band members
- Player's name instead of "Profile / player Name" added to 'REWARD' screen
- Investigated and fixed the bug where half of the gems balance of the player is missing after relaunching the game. 
- Fixed damage number placement after ultimate attacks
- Fixed Stevie Dove hands glitch
- Fixed CG5 cowboy hat clipping
- Fixed Sol Sharp’s small skinning errors
- Fixed Christi Vipera’s wrong victory anim
- Fixed character preview camera getting overridden by game camera when joining new match
- Fixed Stevie Dove missing vfx
- Optimized guest star and Ragnar’s vfx
- Improved some rendering configuration issues
- Fixed the 'Crash' window that often opens after player hitting 'Exit' or 'x' 
- Fixed the 'white block' in the center of the Fame Screen
- Inverted hats fixed
- Menu music returns after the battle

[b]Known Issues and bugs:
[/b]- Sometimes an empty screen appears after launching the game
- First screen animation displays wrong if the game is launched in windowed mode
- Guest Star 'Armstrong' attack does nothing (no animation or damage given) if all the opponents are already KO’d
- Aria modules don’t disappear at the victory screen
- Band displaying preview on main screen could be missing after matches
- Sometimes the player can stuck on the lobby screen
- AVAST flags the .exe as a virus
- Song strategy descriptions are missing

- Minor localization issues

- Players from previous matches could be displayed in the Lobby Screen when the player launches another match
- Sometimes the player could get trapped in a loop at the end of the round
- Order of gems in ‘buy gems’ pop-up is incorrect
- Categories order in ‘Build’ module
- Ragnar’s name
- Some ability names are too long and overlap the logo
- Settings menu screen has old art
- Filters UI has old art
- ‘Congratulations’ pop-up has old art
- ‘Buy gems’ button in ‘rewards’ screen has old art
